**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is part of a software services company in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry.
- [FACT] The user’s company is already generating profits.
- [FACT] The user’s company has little cash runway.
- [FACT] An important client of the user’s company is ending their contract at the end of the month.
- [PREFERENCE] The user wants to focus only on services related to innovation for customers that have already applied BIM.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested several ways to raise funds for an AEC-oriented software services company, including seeking venture capital investments, applying for grants, crowdfunding, seeking loans or lines of credit, and partnering with other companies.
